scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
You... You got younger!!! But you are definitely YOU!
I couldn't think you were able to meet my condition...
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
你……你变年轻了！！！但你确实是你！
我没想到你能满足我的条件……

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
Now go forth and get younger!
If you solve my riddle, then I'll give you a magical Jewel Case with a rare accessory.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
现在去吧，变得更年轻！
如果你解开了我的谜题，我就给你一个装有稀有饰品的魔法珠宝盒。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
{0} The Hero!
Now you're strong.
But... not quite strong for my riddle.
Kill {1} more Seals and return.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
英雄{0}！
你现在很强。
但是……还不足以解开我的谜题。
再去猎杀{1}只海豹宝宝，然后回来。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
{0} The Hero!
Now you're strong.
But... not quite strong for my riddle.
Kill {1} more Poporings and come back.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
英雄{0}！
你现在很强。
但是……还不足以解开我的谜题。
再去猎杀{1}只波波利，然后回来。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
{0} The Hero!
Now you're REALLY strong.
And if you get younger than now I'll give you my treasure.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
英雄{0}！
你现在真的非常强。
如果你能变得比现在更年轻，我就把我的宝物给你。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
Here is your prize. It's yours for good.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
这是你的奖品。它永远属于你了。

scripts.text:
[La Fenn]
I've got a riddle for a strong man of 2nd Class and 99 Base Level.
*Yawn* If you meet some, please tell them about my riddle.
scripts.translation:
[拉·芬恩]
我有一个给二转职业且基本等级达到99级的强者准备的谜题。
*哈欠* 如果你遇到这样的人，请告诉他们关于我的谜题。
